status: development protocol frozen before this run's outcome evaluation; cohorts previously inspected
source_secondary: five already declared defensive-front drills, retained separately by drill
gate: first two consecutive trailing 0.2-second displacement speeds at or above threshold; causal prefix only
axis: observed trailing 0.2-second displacement at gate; independent of NFL outcome
full_history_control: all six forward positions relative to gate and absolute lateral positions, plus kinematics
source_aggregation: independent attempt means per athlete/drill/gate; no pseudo-replicate resampling of windows
primary_target: existing context-adjusted rookie snap-to-LOS get-off; minimum 30 eligible plays
mechanism_target: half-second forward displacement after NFL speed-2 gate; minimum 20 plays; separate gate/entry context model
source_information_control: all conventional measurements plus identical accepted-attempt counts and gate support flags
evaluation: train 2023 test 2024; train 2023-2024 test 2025; all inner context and transforms rebuilt by original player
uncertainty: paired class-stratified player fixed-prediction bootstrap plus separate complete original-player refit sensitivity
decision: lowest predicted quarter per class, compared using same budget and training lower-quartile target threshold
privacy: restricted rows and predictions outside repository; public output aggregate allowlist only
